title: An arrangement about coming back
description: The route, the approximate time and the latest information received are clear to both sides.

blocks.text: Loved ones see a point that is not moving and cannot tell whether the person stopped or lost signal long ago.

quote.text: An absolute must-have app for solo hikers. The automatic notification system gives my family so much peace of mind because they know they'll be alerted with my last known GPS location if I'm overdue coming off the trail. I especially love the crowdsourced cell coverage mapping feature it makes findi

blocks.text: Before setting out, agree on the recipient and on how the messages will work. Show the time next to the position, and distinguish a message that arrived from an attempt to send one.
An automatic alert does not guarantee help. The app has to show clearly where the information it has runs out.
